name: ovallsp
description: Semantic Ruby/Rails language features backed by a standalone Core Language Server.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Static analysis (parsing, completion, definition) works in an untrusted workspace. The Runtime Agent, which executes the workspace's own Rails/Bundler code, only starts once the workspace is trusted.

ovallsp.enabled.description: Enable the OvalLSP Core Language Server.

ovallsp.ruby.command.description: Deprecated synonym for ovallsp.rubyExecutablePath, kept for compatibility. Explicit Ruby interpreter used to launch the Core Server, skipping the mise/asdf/rbenv/chruby/PATH search entirely.

ovallsp.rubyExecutablePath.description: Explicit Ruby interpreter used to launch the Core Server, skipping the mise/asdf/rbenv/chruby/PATH search entirely. When unset, OvalLSP searches mise, asdf, rbenv, chruby, PATH, then (on Windows) common RubyInstaller locations -- see 'OvalLSP: Show Environment Diagnostics' for what was actually picked and why.

ovallsp.server.path.description: Path to the ovallsp Core Server entrypoint. Defaults to the bundled core/bin/ovallsp script.

ovallsp.observation.testCommand.description: Command used by 'OvalLSP: Run Tests with Type Observation', e.g. ["bundle", "exec", "rspec"]. Defaults to the Core Server's own default (bundle exec rspec).

commands.title: OvalLSP: Run Tests with Type Observation

scripts.package: npm run copy-core && npm run compile && vsce package --allow-missing-repository --skip-license
